story.title: Story 4: Smart Compact Snapshot And Rollout Regeneration

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on convergence for SV-04-001. I reviewed the quick-fix changes to the smart-compact lease path and mutation coordinator, confirmed the new SQLite regression test exercises the stale pre-snapshot revision drift through `runSmartCompact(...)`, checked that projection/materialization still use the compact snapshot, and ran the focused Story 4 suites plus the configured `npm run verify-all` gate.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved. `runSmartCompact(...)` now calls `resolveSmartCompactLeaseRevision(...)`, which returns `expectedSourceRevision: undefined` for `SqliteThreadStore` so the pre-snapshot revision-pinned lease no longer throws on live SQLite source drift (`src/commands/smart-compact.ts:132-151`, `src/commands/smart-compact.ts:370-386`). `FileThreadMutationCoordinator.acquireThreadLease(...)` now accepts an optional expected revision and only performs stale revision comparison when it is defined (`src/thread/store/mutation-coordinator.ts:45-99`). The regression test mutates SQLite state during `assertCanMutate`, then proves strict smart compact succeeds, includes the live updated SQLite text, and records the generated-session source revision from the current compact snapshot (`tests/commands/smart-compact-sqlite.test.ts:94-123`, `tests/commands/smart-compact-sqlite.test.ts:189-228`).

productionPathFindings: No material fake adapter, mock runtime path, placeholder branch, or non-real production workaround was found in the reviewed quick-fix surface. The SQLite compact path now lets `readCompactSnapshot(...)` define projection truth after lease acquisition, and `ThreadViewMaterializer` consumes the provided compact snapshot instead of re-reading live state (`src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:887-991`, `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-materializer.ts:692-764`).
additionalObservations: Focused Story 4 suites passed with 6 tests, including the new stale pre-snapshot revision regression.
The configured story gate passed: `npm run verify-all` completed with service tests and E2E tests green.
